review.notes: Full review of the folder at 67b939d (the PR itself only folds NativeCompletion.md into README.md). Gate rerun with --build --order reproduces the worker's FAIL line (set_option=51, tex=14, sorry-data=9, sorry-examples=10, imports=1, readme-ids-missing=11, build=12 module-system advisories); depcheck 225 roadmaps, 2120 edges, 0 problems. Pins verified equal (TauCeti 358314d, Mathlib f6090c7). Seeded sample: LFR (33 names), CFT (18 names) and PC (57 names) contract tables resolve at the supplier heads on main; the PC 'abbreviations of Tau Ceti' claim fails for cup, f2Pairing, homClass, cochainClass, inhomogeneousCochain2, galoisF2Iso (sorry'd defs), on which QFI's Layers 7-9 are built (R01, P1). Duplication audit against the pin: ~110 sorried declarations restate native Tau Ceti declarations (list with file:line in R02); one-tactic probe closes 26 of 28 sampled. Headline 'local classification by (dim,d,s)' is native at the pin and absent from Suggested.lean (R03). 9 sorry'd data + 51 set_option (R04). This PR's fold-in is process material with #print axioms and absolute-path placeholders (R05); 9 files and 5 declarations the README cites as native are absent at the pin, and ownership claims for the Hilbert symbol, the cup-norm criterion and the Galois splitting field are refuted at the pin (R06); gate text rules (R07); garbled sublayer labels and README shape (R08). Sources read: Kahn 1984 (author copy; Thm 2, Lemme II.2.1, Prop II.3.5 verified), Serre CMH 1984 (Collège de France copy; Thm 1'), Kozlowski 1984 (AMS); Lam, O'Meara, Serre CiA/LF, Gille-Szamuely not legally readable here.
